detailSections.title: Prompt Workshop
detailSections.description: Experiment with and refine prompts across multiple AI models to achieve optimal performance and business outcomes.

features.title: Prompt Experimentation
features.description: Test identical prompts across multiple AI models simultaneously, comparing outputs, monitoring token consumption, and measuring response times in real-time.

features.title: Prompt Versioning
features.description: Monitor, control, and rollback prompt modifications across the AI agent development cycle, maintaining uniformity and enabling swift iterations at enterprise scale.

features.title: 60+ Prompt Libraries
features.description: Fast-track your AI development with ready-to-use prompt libraries for data classification, content summarization, generation workflows, and more—no need to build from zero.

detailSections.title: Model Orchestrator
detailSections.description: Empower your team to easily integrate, manage, and connect multiple AI models, whether commercial, fine-tuned, or open source, within a single agentic workflow.

features.title: Enterprise Models
features.description: Integrate any enterprise AI model from OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and leading providers directly into GenX Platform.

features.title: Open-Source Integration
features.description: Access open-source AI models seamlessly through HuggingFace connectivity, unlocking millions of models for diverse applications.

features.title: Custom Models
features.description: Train large language models using your proprietary data or deploy your own specialized models for industry-specific requirements.

detailSections.title: Quality Assurance Lab
detailSections.description: Assess the performance of both AI models and agentic applications to ensure quality, accurate, less biased, compliant, and reliable AI agent responses before and after deployment.

features.title: Response Validation
features.description: Identify AI model hallucinations during development and rapidly optimize them through test datasets or human-in-the-loop feedback for precision.

features.title: Query Alignment
features.description: Assess whether AI agent outputs effectively address user inquiries using integrated evaluators or custom-built validation frameworks.

features.title: Behavior Testing
features.description: Verify your AI agents perform as intended and utilize appropriate tools for each situation by creating and validating custom test scenarios aligned with your operations.

governancePillars.title: Automatic Validation
governancePillars.description: Every model passes quality gates before deployment

governancePillars.title: Compliance Built-In
governancePillars.description: SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA compliance out of the box
